root_cause.text: The `handle_one_ule_extension` function in `dvb_net.c` fails to validate that the network-controlled index `htype` is within the bounds of the 255-element `ule_mandatory_ext_handlers` and `ule_optional_ext_handlers` arrays before using it to access them.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a bounds check `if (htype >= ARRAY_SIZE(ule_mandatory_ext_handlers)) return -1;` immediately after `htype` is calculated as `p->ule_sndu_type & 0x00FF`, preventing an out-of-bounds read when `htype` equals 255.

bic_trace_step.reason: The arrays `ule_mandatory_ext_handlers` and `ule_optional_ext_handlers` are defined with a size of 255 (lines 244 and 248). The index `htype` is defined as an `unsigned char` (line 252), which can hold values from 0 to 255. When `htype` is 255, accessing `ule_mandatory_ext_handlers[htype]` (lines 257-258) and `ule_optional_ext_handlers[htype]` (lines 273-274) results in an out-of-bounds read/execution because the valid index range is only 0 to 254. There is no boundary check before these accesses.
